name: Erovnuli Liga
content:
The Erovnuli Liga is the top professional football division in Georgia and the highest level of the country’s league system. It was established in 1990 after Georgian clubs left the Soviet football structure, and it is organized by the Georgian Football Federation. The league represents the first tier of Georgian football and serves as the main competition for determining the national champion.

The league currently consists of 10 clubs that compete in a round-robin format, playing each other multiple times during the season. At the end of the season, the lowest-ranked team is relegated to the second division, while teams near the bottom may also face playoff matches. The champion qualifies for the UEFA Champions League qualifiers, while other top teams earn places in UEFA’s secondary club competitions.

Over its history, the league has changed structure several times, including the number of participating teams and the competition format. Since 2017, it has followed a stable 10-team system with a spring-to-autumn calendar. Dinamo Tbilisi is the most successful club in the league’s history, holding the record for the most championships and remaining a dominant force in Georgian football.
